trigger.custom:
function(a, e, t)
    local currentMana = UnitPower("player" , 0)
    local fsrDuration = 5
    
    if currentMana >= UnitPowerMax("player", 0) then
        return false
    end
    
    if e == "UNIT_POWER_FREQUENT" and currentMana > aura_env.lastMana then
        
        -- if the condition isn't met, the current tick occured during FSR duration
        -- probably due to talents like Meditation or set bonuses
        -- we will therefore ignore this tick and not overwrite the animation
        if GetTime() >= aura_env.lastCast + fsrDuration then 
            
            local duration = 2
            a[""] = {
                show = true,
                changed = true,
                duration = duration,
                expirationTime = GetTime() + duration,
                progressType = "timed",
                autoHide = true
            }
        end
        
        -- print mana gained from tick for debugging:
        -- print('mana tick: ' .. (currentMana - aura_env.lastMana))
        
        aura_env.lastMana = currentMana
        
    elseif e == "UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED" and currentMana < aura_env.lastMana then
        local duration = fsrDuration
        a[""] = {
            show = true,
            changed = true,
            duration = duration,
            expirationTime = GetTime() + duration,
            progressType = "timed",
            autoHide = true
        }
        aura_env.lastMana = currentMana
        aura_env.lastCast = GetTime()
    end
    
    --aura_env.lastMana = currentMana
    return true
end

function(event, ...)
    if event == "UNIT_DAMAGE" then
        local current = GetInventoryItemLink("player", GetInventorySlotInfo("MainHandSlot"))
        if current ~= aura_env.mainhand then
            aura_env.stacks = 0
            aura_env.mainhand = current
        end
    elseif event == "PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD" then
        local isInitialLogin, isReloadingUi = ...
        if isInitialLogin == false and isReloadingUi == false then
            aura_env.stacks = 0
        end
    elseif event == "COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED" then
        local subevent = select(2, ...)
        local name = select(5, ...)
        local spellID = select(12, ...)
        local stacks = select(16, ...)
        if name ~= UnitName("player") then return end
        if subevent == "SPELL_EXTRA_ATTACKS" then
            aura_env.stacks = aura_env.stacks + 1
            if aura_env.stacks > 4 then aura_env.stacks = 4 end
        elseif subevent == "SWING_DAMAGE" or subevent == "SWING_MISSED" then
            aura_env.stacks = 0
        end
    end
    
    return true
end
